notes.title: 🌟 Brave New Wonders at PAX WEST and MIX Fall Showcase 2025! 🌟
notes.content: [p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Brave New Wonders[/b] is part of the MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025 in Seattle! 🎉[/p][p]✨ You can play our latest build both [b]onsite at the MIX event[/b] at Block 41, 115 Bell St at 7–11pm and PAX WEST at PAX TOGETHER D4G booth. notes.title: Playtest Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello Pioneers,

The wait is (almost) over! We're thrilled to announce that the Playtest for Brave New Wonders is just around the corner! 🚀

The Playtest page is now live! Simply click "Request Access" on the Steam page, and you'll be notified as soon as your request is approved. Share your thoughts, help us improve, and we’ll thank you in the credits! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45456826/7a88afb6860f8bbbb5c326e857892c5aa3637f8c.jpg[/img]

We’re unable to control who receives access through Steam’s Playtest settings, but we can send individual keys to pioneers who sign up at [b]www.BraveNewWonders.com.[/b]

To ensure the redeem key reaches your inbox safely, please [b]confirm your signup[/b] and mark the confirmation email as “Not Spam” if it ends up in your spam folder.

Thank you for your support!


Sala
@ City From Naught

notes.title: Announcing Brave New Wonders!
notes.content:
Hi Pioneers!

We are City From Naught, an indie game studio from Toronto and we're excited to announce our new factory automation game: Brave New Wonders! 

In Brave New Wonders you explore a post-apocalyptic world, discover ruins from the past, battle with enemies, collect resources, and optimize your own automated factories! 

In addition to being a fun strategy simulator, you can command automatons with customized instructions via support from the Large Language Model! We’re excited to create a new experience for AI in games. We believe AI should not only be limited to creating in-game assets or automating workflows but also making the game more fun and creating new possibilities. Brave New Wonders will introduce interactivity unlike anything you've ever seen in simulation games, and make the experience of organizing your workforce even more magical. 

We still have a lot of development ahead of us, with a lot of trial and error, close beta tests, demos, etc. But in the meantime, we're very excited to share the first look of Brave New Wonders with you! Let us know what you think! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2403830/Brave_New_Wonders 


Cheers!
Sala @ City From Naught
